rules.name: even_ranks_only
rules.description: Only cards with an even rank (2,4,6,8,10,12) may be played.

rules.name: opposite_parity_rank
rules.description: Card rank must have opposite odd/even parity to the previous card's rank.

rules.name: spades_only
rules.description: Only cards of the suit spades may be played.

rules.name: different_suit_same_color
rules.description: The card must be of a different suit than but same color as the card just before it. Any card may start the line.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
prev = mainline[-1]
return card.color == prev.color and card.suit.suit_name != prev.suit.suit_name

rules.name: red_increase_black_decrease_wrap
rules.description: If the previous card was red, rank must increase; if black, rank must decrease. Ace may follow King and vice versa.
